units.source_text: 从黑177到白180，大竹七段也思绪沸腾，心荡神驰。

en.t: From Black 177 to White 180, Otake 7-dan too was swept up in surging thoughts, his spirit stirred and carried away.

units.source_text: 他那张丰满的圆脸，活像一尊十全十美的佛脸。

en.t: His full, round face looked exactly like the flawless face of a Buddha.

units.source_text: 也许是进入了心旷神怡的艺术境界，显出无法形容的美。

en.t: Perhaps he had entered an artistic realm of pure openness and delight, revealing an indescribable beauty.

units.source_text: 他似乎没想起肚子不好的事。

en.t: He seemed not to have remembered his stomach trouble.
